scope: Development reuse of spent S3 public 2023/2024 survivor histories; no fresh confirmation or investment inference
question: Does dimension-independent distance weighting improve residual correction over the original distance on a recent frozen base with conservative selection?
contribution: Bounded diagnostic intervention on known methods; novelty not claimed
base: Last 96 pre-validation decision dates; core48/selection12/calibration12/residual24, strict label maturity purges; 5 epochs CPU batch32 patience3
calibration: Inherited S3 grid fitted only chronological calibration block; retain raw reference
correction: Mean only; risk power zero isolates distance without changing variance estimand; keys multiplied sqrt(d) to turn existing mean squared distance into squared Euclidean distance; temperature fixed1
selection: Weights0,.25,.5,1; two chronological halves of outer validation. Nonzero eligible only if each half improves date-balanced NLL over weight0 by more than .01; choose lowest whole-validation NLL, tie smaller weight. No evaluation labels used in selection.
primary: Euclidean minus old distance under same recent base and gate; also gains against off; descriptive only, all seeds/folds retained. Existing inspected windows are development, not support for original confirmatory claim.
